auxiliary_source_cv_valid: official train labels only, OTHER tasks; target task column completely removed
auxiliary_source_final: official train+valid labels only, OTHER tasks; never test labels
auxiliary_identity: canonical nonisomeric molecular identity, aggregate median regression / mean classification
auxiliary_missing: zero standardized assay value plus explicit binary observed mask
fold_source: target task rows in v24 scaffold folds
evaluation_interpretation: Conditional prediction with genuinely available other-task assays; auxiliary labels of a held target scaffold may be present, so this is NOT global unknown-scaffold validation
classification_loss: Logloss; pos_weight sqrt inverse prevalence capped 3
objective: 0.6 full historical v24 valid gain + 0.4 conditional CV gain relative v24 neural branch - 0.1 CV SD
eligibility: valid gain >0.0001, mean CV gain >-0.01, at least one nonnegative CV fold, objective >0.0001
limitation: History-reused valid, conditional-assay CV rather than entirely unknown molecular scaffold, official score formula unknown
